sessionStart.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.cursor/hooks/_run.py" session_start >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.cursor/hooks/_run.py" before_submit_prompt >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'

afterFileEdit.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.cursor/hooks/_run.py" after_file_edit >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'

afterTabFileEdit.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.cursor/hooks/_run.py" after_tab_file_edit >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'

stop.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.cursor/hooks/_run.py" stop >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'

sessionEnd.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.cursor/hooks/_run.py" session_end >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'
